# Security policy

Please report a security problem privately. Do not open a public issue or pull request for it.

Go to the repository's Security tab and choose "Report a vulnerability". That opens a private
advisory that only you and the maintainers can see. Include what you found, how to reproduce it
and which version or commit you tested.

You will get a reply in the advisory. Please give us a reasonable time to fix the problem before
you talk about it publicly.
